name: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 - Path Traversal and RCE
description: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 is vulnerable to a path traversal flaw that maps URLs to files outside the configured document root. Where mod_cgi is enabled it can lead to remote code execution. Actively exploited in the wild.
remediation: Upgrade to Apache HTTP Server 2.4.51 or later (2.4.50 is an incomplete fix). Ensure 'require all denied' is set for filesystem locations.
